events.description:
SF founders throw house parties on Friday nights. Boston founders network on Tuesdays at 6pm. Let's change that.
After a few weeks out in SF, I'm throwing the first Boston founder house party. When I posted about this on
LinkedIn
and
Instagram
, it went semi-viral. It got 70K+ impressions and a flood of DMs from people asking when it was happening. Everyone was begging for it, so we decided to actually do something about it.
So here it is. We're keeping the first one small and bringing together a hand-picked group of Boston's best founders and builders for a Friday night where you can actually let loose. If this becomes a thing, you'll want to say you were at the first one.
Bella Pivo and I are hosting it at her apartment in Cambridge. The exact address goes out to approved guests.
Space is very limited and every guest is approved by hand. If there's someone you think should be there, message one of us!
